## Analysis summary

**Window activity is not itself the evidence.** The window [39646, 51646] holds 2746 events (step_03/04), which is high but comparable to neighbouring windows (step_07); the raw closure rate (~0.077 closures/event) is similar to windows at 32000 and 72000. So volume alone doesn't distinguish it.

**The specific signal is on the cited nodes.** Each of the 12 listed nodes is low-degree (2–5 contacts in-window, step_08), yet every single one participates in exactly one prompt wedge→closure (step_09, step_12, step_18):

| closing edge | t | shared contact | lag |
|---|---|---|---|
| 144–1908 | 43478 | 952 | 62 |
| 1455–1693 | 44609 | **233** | 556 |
| 38–1348 | 44784 | 820 | 537 |
| 1927–222 | 44864 | 862 | 102 |
| 452–34 | 45144 | 617 | 509 |
| 237–15 | 46986 | 464 | 31 |
| 1926–704 | 47543 | **118** | 620 |
| 127–728 | 47782 | 398 | 414 |
| 1338–99 | 48336 | 1951 | 66 |
| 54–1685 | 48569 | 628 | 158 |
| 306–220 | 49904 | 1554 | 465 |

All lags ≤ 800 (max 620), all closing edges are **first-ever** contacts between those pairs (step_17), so this is genuine novel closure, not repetition of a pre-existing tie. The wave is temporally compact (43478–49904, inside the window) and 11 of the 12 whole-log E-closures fall in it (step_13).

**Confounder controls.**
- *Timestamp shuffling* (degree/pair structure preserved, timing destroyed): 0–1 E-involving closures across 5 shuffles vs 11 observed (step_15); global window closures drop 205 → 135–148 (step_10).
- *Degree-matched null*: among 912 non-E nodes with in-window degree 2–5, only 16.4% have ≥1 closure; all 12 E nodes do (p ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁰, step_14, step_18). Popularity/degree cannot explain it.
- *Δ sensitivity*: relaxing Δ from 800 to 12000 adds only 3 more E-closures (step_16) — the signal lives at short lags, not in "connected eventually".
- *Caveat*: the time-reversed control still yields ~11 E-closures in the mirrored window (step_10, step_15), i.e. the wedge/closure ordering is partly symmetric locally; this tempers, but does not overturn, the causal reading.
